ana.common.stale: The newer figures could not be read; the screen keeps the previous reading.
ana.common.unverified.body: The parameters of this calculation are starting values of the research that the organisation has not approved; read the result as indicative.
ana.forecast.page.title: Year-end disbursement outlook
ana.forecast.page.subtitle: A band from the speed of the last 4 to 8 weeks, the seasonal shape of the year before, and what has to be paid each week to reach the plan.
ana.forecast.basis.pm: Plan assigned by the Prime Minister
ana.forecast.tile.band: Band from {low} to {high}; {ratio}% of the plan
ana.forecast.tile.needed: Needed each week to reach the plan
ana.forecast.tile.multiple: {multiple} times the recent pace ({speed} dong a week)
ana.forecast.tile.reached: The plan is reached, nothing more is needed
ana.forecast.tile.gap: Gap to the plan (middle of the band)
ana.forecast.tile.attention: Under {pct}% of the plan: to watch
ana.forecast.chart.title: Cumulative and projection band
ana.forecast.chart.caption: Chart of the cumulative disbursement by week, three projections to the year end and the plan line
ana.forecast.chart.seasonal: Projection on last year's seasonal shape
ana.forecast.chart.caveat: The band is the speed measured over windows of {min} to {max} weeks, carried in a straight line to the end of the plan year; it is a pace projection, not a promise.
ana.forecast.windows.title: Each speed window
ana.forecast.windows.aria: Projection for each window of weeks
ana.forecast.windows.caption: Each row is a window of weeks: the weekly speed and the year-end projection in a straight line and on the seasonal shape
ana.forecast.windows.skipped: Windows skipped because no week point fits or the cumulative fell: {weeks} weeks.
ana.forecast.funds.title: By fund source
ana.forecast.funds.caption: Each row is a fund source with its cumulative, plan, year-end projection, ratio to the plan and the amount needed each week
ana.forecast.empty.title: No outlook yet
ana.forecast.gated.title: Indicator not certified
ana.forecast.gated.notCertified: Leaders see figures on certified definitions only; the definition of the disbursement rate is not certified, so the outlook is not shown.
ana.forecast.gated.obsolete: The definition of the disbursement rate is obsolete, so the outlook is not shown.
ana.forecast.na.noPlan: There is no year plan to compare with.
ana.forecast.na.noTreasury: The Treasury has booked no disbursement yet, so there is nothing to project.
ana.forecast.na.tooFewWeeks: Not enough weeks of figures for one speed window.
ana.forecast.na.unusable: Every window is unusable because the cumulative fell.
ana.forecast.na.noSnapshot: There is no frozen snapshot yet.
ana.forecast.na.noPriorYear: There is no weekly series of the year before to take the season from.
ana.forecast.na.priorShort: The year before does not reach its year end, so no seasonal shape is taken.
ana.forecast.na.priorZero: The year before paid nothing in the matching window, so there is no pace ratio.
ana.forecast.na.seasonOff: The rule has seasonality switched off.
ana.forecast.na.zeroSpeed: The recent pace is zero, so the multiple cannot be computed.
ana.forecast.na.noSpeed: The recent pace could not be measured.
ana.forecast.na.other: It cannot be computed because data is missing.
